description: Inspect SSH public keys and OpenSSH certificates from authorized_keys, known_hosts, .pub, RFC 4716 or PEM input: key type, size / curve, SHA256 and MD5 fingerprints exactly as ssh-keygen prints them, comment and authorized_keys options, FIDO / hardware-backed keys, duplicate detection and a strength verdict (DSA and short RSA flagged); certificates are decoded (user/host, key ID, principals, validity, critical options, extensions, signing CA fingerprint). PEM public keys are converted to OpenSSH format. Private keys are refused. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ssh-key-info

keys.description: One key per line (authorized_keys / known_hosts / .pub), or an RFC 4716 / PEM public key block

name: ssh_key_info
title: Ssh Key Info
